headline: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
context: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.
